Citymaker.LogisticsYard.Name: Logistics yard
Citymaker.Recipe.LogisticsYard.Descripti: A storage and loading yard laid out like a parking lot: container stacks, pallets, crates or lumber in blocks between drive aisles, truck loading bays, sheds and floodlights.
Citymaker.LogisticsYard.style.Tooltip: What fills the storage blocks. Mixed varies the goods from block to block.
Citymaker.LogisticsYard.aisleWidth.Toolt: Width of the drive aisles between the storage blocks (forklifts need 4 m, trucks 8 m or more).
Citymaker.LogisticsYard.blockDepth.Toolt: Depth of each storage block between two aisles. Deeper blocks hold more rows.
Citymaker.LogisticsYard.blockLength.Tool: Length of a storage block before the next cross aisle.
Citymaker.LogisticsYard.fill.Tooltip: Share of the storage slots that hold goods. Lower looks like a yard mid-shift.
Citymaker.LogisticsYard.angle.Tooltip: Rotates the aisle grid against the area's long axis.
Citymaker.LogisticsYard.dockSide.Tooltip: Where the truck loading bays go: the edge far from the entrance (back), near it (front), two edges, or none.
Citymaker.LogisticsYard.trucks.Tooltip: Share of the loading bays with a truck or trailer backed in.
Citymaker.LogisticsYard.sheds.Tooltip: Warehouse sheds or lean-tos along the edge behind the loading bays.
Citymaker.LogisticsYard.machines.Tooltip: Forklifts, reach stackers and yard tractors per hectare, working the aisles.
Citymaker.LogisticsYard.gatehouse.Toolti: A guard booth and boom barrier at the main entrance.
Citymaker.LogisticsYard.office.Tooltip: A site office cabin next to the entrance lane.
Citymaker.LogisticsYard.markings.Tooltip: Painted aisle lines, block outlines and bay lines (hard ground only).
Citymaker.LogisticsYard.stains.Tooltip: Oil, dirt and puddle decals per 100 m², in clumps.
Citymaker.LogisticsYard.level.Tooltip: Levels the yard so stacks stand flat, blended back to the ground at the outline (permanent).
Citymaker.LogisticsYard.buffer.Tooltip: A planted strip of this width between the outline and the yard.
Citymaker.LogisticsYard.Issue.NoBuffer: Logistics yard: the area is too narrow for the green buffer; the yard fills it all.
Citymaker.AddOn.YardBreak.Name: Break area
Citymaker.AddOn.YardBreak.cabin.Tooltip: A cabin or shed for the yard crew.
